jobs.description:
We are looking for an Administrative Assistant with over 2 years of experience in administration for our client.
 

What are your tasks?
 
 
 
• Keep agendas up-to-date and ensure consistency amongst Executives’ activities 
 
• Follow-up meetings/conferences/registrations and invitation to meetings/conferences etc. 
 
• Arrange travel plans (flights, hotel reservations etc.). 
 
• Format documents and send e-mail/letters 
 
• Assist with the preparation and the formatting of presentations (PowerPoint) 
 
• Keep our SharePoint up-to-date with meeting materials etc. 
 
• Keep our contact database up to date 
 
• Follow up of contracts with external parties and ensure their appropriate recording in the contract database. 
 
• Collecting and providing all relevant information for internal/external meetings 
 
• Sending outlook invitations and tracking replies 
 
• Gathering working documents, preparing meeting folders and checking presentations’ accuracy 
 
• Organizing Microsoft Teams meetings when relevant 
 
• Ordering lunches 
 
• Setting up meeting rooms for calls and face to face meetings 
 
• Answer phone calls and welcome visitors 

Skills & Competences:
 
 
 
• You possess a degree/diploma/certificate in Administration or relevant 
 
• At least 2 years of experience 
 
• Past experience of working in an international environment is an asset 
 
• Excellent spoken and written in English, dutch and french is a prerequisite 
 
• Excellent computer skills (Word, PowerPoint, Excel...) 
 
• Team worker 
 
• Being proactive 
 
• Good oral and written communication abilities 
 
• Flexible, diplomatic, with good cultural sensitivity o Independent and autonomous 
 
• Eager to learn 
 
• Able to respect deadlines and tight timing

Description
 
 
 
• The assistant will be the first point of contact for callers and visitors and will be responsible for the meeting rooms - taking telephone calls, welcoming visitors, and booking meeting venues. 
 
• The successful candidate will also provide general support to the day-to-day running of the office in Brussels and the organization of various meetings and events.  
 
• He/she will report to the Senior Officer and to the Secretary General of the Association. 
 
• Essential Duties & Responsibilities 
 
• Handle incoming calls and coordinate messages as needed. 
 
• Provide assistance and support to the Senior Officer and Secretary General. 
 
• Day-to-day office management: liaise with suppliers, organize incoming mail and postal services, and maintain office/food supplies and other requirements to keep the office running smoothly including office equipment and office space. 
 
• Administrative and financial work: filing invoices, prepare payments. 
 
• Provide administrative support in booking travel, filing, and updating contacts. 
 
• Provide logistical and administrative support in the organization of internal and external meetings and events. 
 
• Provide ad hoc logistical support to international colleagues for organizing meetings in Brussels. 
 
• Update and manage the website. 
 
• Manage orders of office supplies, courier services, catering, cleaning staff etc.  
 
• Liaise with IT service providers, designers, printers, translators, etc.  
 
• Manage membership fees for members. 
 
• Assist in preparing the annual General Assembly. 
 
• Perform other related duties as required. 
 
• Taking minutes during the Committees and Working Groups meetingsEducation / Experience 
 
• At least three years of relevant experience in administrative support. 
 
• Secretarial studies is an asset. 

Skills Required
 
 
 
• Fluency in French and English - other languages is an asset. 
 
• Excellent communication and organizational skills. 
 
• Excellent computer skills (MS Office, experience with databases, etc.). 
 
• Comfortable in multi-tasking, detail-oriented, and working to deadlines. 
 
• Flexible and adaptable approach to work. 
 
• Basic accounting knowledge. Compensation

Your mission:
 

•   Office management: visitors' reception, expense reports, mail handling, management of the office supplies, management of the meeting rooms, organization of meetings and trade shows, invoices... 

 
• bull;   Sales & Customer service support:  
o    General customer service support during peak season  o    Take off work from customer service representatives to allow them to take care of most of the order management of regular and recurring unit orders o    Assist the sales team with any support work such as: calling customers monthly to check their needs with them for the rolling forecast, proactively following up in writing on smaller quotes (during peak season from March to July) o    Marketing support during trade shows o    Organize sales trips/shows for Area Managers (logistics and visit appointments, hotels, flights, car rentals) o    Follow up with Area Managers to make sure action item deadlines are observed o    Handle market surveys by phone and analyze the answers and report the conclusion and /or recommendations o    Communicate with sales team about validated prospects and their needs o    Support the sales team with collection calls

Your profile: 

 
• bull;    You have 2-3 years experience in a similar role 
 
• bull;    You can communicate easily in French, English and Dutch, oral and written. Any additional European language is a plus 
 
• bull;    You have a very good knowledge of Outlook, Word and Excel 
Your competencies: 

 
• bull;    You are customer oriented 
 
• bull;    You have administrative, record-keeping, and clerical skills; 
 
• bull;    You can work in a fast and demanding environment in a multitasking mode 
 
• bull;    You have strong interpersonal skills; 
 
• bull;    You can manage priorities and you have an eye for details 
 
• bull;    You are a problem-solver  
 
• bull;    You are organized and rigorous

As Customer Service you will work in the office in Brussels and you will be responsible of the Spanish and Italian markets.

Client Details

The company is Belgian and operates from Brussels. They are active in the (sustainable) fashion industry and are having beautiful projects on international level.

Description

As a Customer Service Spain/Italy you will have following responsibilities:

• Responding to customer inquiries via phone and email in Spanish, Italian and English
• Providing detailed information about products and services
• Processing orders and ensuring accurate data entry
• Resolving customer complaints in a timely and effective manner
• Collaborating with internal teams to address customer needs
• Monitoring and following up on delivery statuses
• Maintaining up-to-date customer records and documentation
• Ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction at all times

As Customer Service Spanish/Italian you have following profile:

• A First experience in a client oriented role (customer service, inside sales, sales support, ...)
• Fluent knowledge of Italian, Spanish and English
• Strong organisational and problem-solving skills
• Attention to detail and accuracy in data entry
• Ability to work effectively in a team environment
• Proficiency with standard office software and CRM systems
• A proactive and customer-oriented mindset

Primary responsibilities project management support (50%):
 
 
 
• Creating timelines and contributing to effective planning of funded project activities. 
 
• Monitoring budgets of EU-funded projects and tracking team members’ time dedication consistently, systematically, and coherently. 
 
• Supporting team members in completing tasks, drafting, and submitting reports. 
 
• Oversee and implement the communication and dissemination tasks of projects. 
 
• Support organising conferences, events, meetings, and other activities linked to projects. 
 
• Providing communication support to Processes4Planet projects. 
 

 Communications activities and providing value to members (50%)
 
 
 
• Create a yearly Communication Plan and track its implementation, 
 
• Manage and enhance the Association’s external communication channels (website, social media, newsletters, etc.),  
 
• Operate members-only collaboration tools (e.g. SharePoint), 
 
• Manage internal communication with company members by operating the existing tools or suggesting new ideas. 
 
• Generate and write content for social media, news releases, newsletters, bulletins, etc. 
 
• Prepare presentations and small publications and manage relations with providers. 
 
• Support to facilitate networking activities  
 
• Organiseparticipation in external conferences, and support with organization of internal events (conferences, workshops, webinars, etc.). 

Qualifications and experience:
 
 
 
• Degree in project management, communications, public relations, business administration or related studies. 
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in positions dealing with the tasks described for this position, with excellent performance. 
 
• Experience with EU funds is an asset. 
 

 Your key skills:
 
 
 
• An energetic person with a hands-on approach, task-oriented with attention to detail 
 
• Team player with a cooperative spirit 
 
• Ability to work in a small core team and diverse virtual teams with people across organizational boundaries and several countries/regions. 
 
• Outstanding organisation and prioritization skills with a capacity to retro plan and fulfil strict deadlines. 
 
• High-quality results and output oriented. 
 
• Capacity to work with complexity and to juggle a variety of tasks flexibly and proactively. 
 
• Creative problem-solving skills, able to anticipate needs and deliver your work autonomously 
 

 
 

Technical skills and languages:
 
 
 
• Strong skills in Word, PowerPoint, Excel and collaborative online tools (e.g. SharePoint). 
 
• Experience in project management. 
 
• Excellent spoken and written English. Other languages are an asset.

Join Traxial (A Magnax Company) as a Mechanical Design Engineer and take ownership of Precision Gearboxes, working from concept to prototype and production.
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

• Design precision gearboxes for new product applications, from concept to production. 

• Design mechanical components: gears, shafts, bearings, housings, seals, and other transmission elements. 

• Create 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying industry standards and GD&T. 

• Perform mechanical calculations and design verification. 

• Work with suppliers and subcontractors on components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specs. 

• Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of gearbox and actuator designs. 
 

• Master's in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience. 

• 3+ years designing gearboxes, drivetrains, or precision mechanical components. 

• Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools. 

• Knowledge of gearbox materials and manufacturing: gear machining, heat treatment, tolerancing, DFM principles. 

• Strong analytical skills, including gear sizing, shaft strength, and bearing selection calculations. 

• Romax, KISSsoft, or similar gear calculation software is a plus. 

• Existing work authorization in Belgium required. 

• Team player, creative, can-do mindset, fluent English.

Searching for a job in sales?

Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?

The company is Belgium based, but are you willing to travel extensively within the DACH region?

“ 
We make it possible” is not just a slogan, it is our mission. Our growth is driven by our expertise and commitment, within an organization that values diversity and equal opportunities.
 

As part of the development of our activities in Belgium and the Netherlands, we are looking for an Administrative and Finance Officer to strengthen our administrative and financial team. You will work closely with the Director of Administration & Development in Belgium and actively contribute to financial monitoring and performance analysis, supporting both local teams and management in Belgium and France.
 

We invest in your professional development and in recognizing your financial expertise. Together, we are building a future of innovation, reliability, and team spirit.
 

Profile:
 

As an Administrative and Finance Officer, you provide essential administrative support to the Director and ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the company’s administration.
 

In this versatile and hands-on role, you will be responsible for various aspects of the company’s administration. You ensure that information is accurate, documents are up to date and files are properly followed up. You enjoy bringing order and structure to information and quickly identifying errors or missing elements.
 

You are meticulous, flexible and motivated to contribute to the development of a fast-growing company.
 

Your responsibilities :
 
 

• Manage and follow up on the company’s general administration 

• Check, process and follow up on invoices and payments 

• Monitor and update financial data and cost centres 

• Prepare and update various reports and tracking tools 

• Check, structure and maintain Excel files and other administrative documents 

• Organise and improve existing administrative data and tools 

• Provide administrative support for commercial activities and sales 

• Provide administrative support to the Director in the development of the company and on various projects 

• Prepare, collect and structure the information required by the Director 

• Follow up on various administrative actions and ensure deadlines are met  

In our small company with a straightforward organisational structure, this role is deliberately broad and varied. You are a trusted person who ensures that the company’s administration is well organised and who actively contributes to structuring and improving its day-to-day operations.

What you bring :
 
 

• Degree in accounting, business administration, management or a similar field 

• Excellent command of French, Dutch and English, both written and spoken 

• Good knowledge of Excel and an interest in analysing financial data 

• Analytical mindset, strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills 

• Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with management

This position is responsible for the employer's day-to-day financial and general administration. They will be part of the Secretariat team, reporting to the Finances Coordinator and supporting the Operations Coordinator. The position is well suited for someone who is highly organised, detail-oriented and motivated to play a supportive role in a dynamic, purpose-driven, international team.

The specific responsibilities of the Finance and Admin Assistant will include & relate to:

Accounting duties and reporting tasks

• Liaise with the accountant to ensure accurate monthly bookkeeping
• Assist in reconciling accounts, preparing summaries, and checking entries
• Assist in preparing donor financial reports
• Prepare out going invoices including membership fees - Keeping track of fee payments 
• Track expenditure against grant budgets in collaboration with the Coordinator
• Checking and filing of financial reports of sub-grantees with their supporting documents
• Other financial tasks as necessary
Preparatory work to an effective & reliable bookkeeping 

• Handle supplier relationships (ordering-payment-checking invoices) 
• Chasing receipt and checking validity of expense claims within the deadlines, including follow up 
• Maintain the financial filing system and ensure documentation is audit-ready
• Other finance admin tasks as necessary
Support office management & general administration

• Support general administration, including but not limited to: office management, filing, membership administration 
• Undertake other administrative or logistical tasks as support to the Operations Coordinator, including for example scheduling, maintaining records, taking minutes at meetings, or preparing documents 
We are looking for a candidate with:

• 1-2 years of relevant experience in accounting
• Education in accounting (Belgian if possible)
• Good organisational skills and attention to detail
• Ability to follow procedures and maintain documentation
• Trustworthiness and discretion handling financial information
• Fluency in written & spoken English and French, other EU languages are an asset
• Ability to provide 2 professional references, if selected
In addition, it is an asset if the candidate has any of the following:

• Experience of working with or for non-governmental organisations or membership-based networks
• Experience in an international, multi-cultural environment
• Knowledge of winbooks 
• Gross salary range: 2300 to 2900 euros
• Benefits: 13th month, lunch tickets, full hospitalisation & pension insurance
• Location: Saint-Josse, Brussels
• Preferred starting date: September/October 2026
• Type of contract: Full-time 1-year contract
• The successful candidate must be either an EU citizen or in possession of a valid work permit for Belgium.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Developer NL/EN- Full Package, Marketing Industry M/W/X
jobs.description:
Senior Business Developer - Your Role

This is a hybrid role combining hunting/sales development and farming/account management. Your daily tasks include but are not limited to: 

• Approaching new customers is an essential part of your job: presentation of your service, review your prospects' product lines, identify promising solutions, offering custom solutions for specific prospects, deal closing
• Maintaining quality relationships with existing customers: act as a first point of contact, provide them with tailor-made analyses and solutions, contract renewal & upselling
• Keeping a close eye on current trends in the FMCG market
• Working hand in hand with your binome and a sales assistant to maintain reliable, updated customer data
• Creating and nurturing a network, attending regular events 
Senior Business Developer - About You

• You have at least 3 years of experience as a business/sales developer, preferably in retail or FMCG
• You are fluent in Dutch and English, French is an asset
• You are a salesperson at heart, either born or made! You are not afraid to pick up the phone, meet prospects, with a focus on results!
• While being social and client-oriented, you demonstrate rigor, exactitude and attention to detail 
Senior Business Developer - The Offer

• A competitive salary package with a competitive fixed pay and a generous commission system. The package also includes extralegal benefits such as a company car, meal vouchers, hospitalization insurance, phone subscription
• You will be part of a driven, dynamic, and experienced team in a fast-growing business environment. This is an ideal position for a motivated sales specialist who wants to take their career to the next level, with perspectives to grow to a management position in the future
• The offices are located in a green and pleasant neighborhood and are easily accessible by car or public transport.
• Working from home is possible (1 day per week). In addition to the 20 legal vacation days, you will receive 10 extra vacation days per year
